# Output stage

*Not yet started.* The output stage covers the wiring around the [EL34 output sockets](../../components/el34-output-tube.md) (V2, V3, V6, V7) and the [A-470 output transformers](../../components/a-470-output-transformer.md) — plate connections, screen connections via UL taps, cathode networks, and the global [feedback](../../theory/feedback.md) loop.

Comes after the [driver stage](../driver-stage/index.md).
